description: J36 report, Deviations and Open question 4: the four J36 packs (ui_art, icon, panel_frame, button_state; 709 MB) were installed sha-checked and uninstalled, but the game never loaded them, because the game folder had no proxy and the watcher refuses a headless launch without it. Deploy the proxy through the existing kit, install the packs, make a headless launch to campaign and to a battle, and close the open engine facts napoleon.ui_art.pack_loads (no crash, the upscaled files are the ones read, shots before and after) and napoleon.ui_art.dds_at_tga_paths (does the engine load DDS at a TGA path; if yes, J36's TGA outputs can become DDS with mips). Add the new packs to the mod_packs skip list. The J36 kill criterion 'any crash when the packed files load' is decided here.
title: UI art packs load in game
